privacyText: Ichi chishandiso chinoshandisa chechitatu-bato AI masevhisi kugadzirisa mibvunzo yemushandisi. Nhaurirano dzinobviswa kana wasiya peji ino. Ndokumbira usatumire ruzivo rwakadzama kana ruzivo rwemunhu.
aboutDescription: Chombo ichi chakagadzirwa neYahya Qanie, nerutsigiro kubva kuSaji Prelis yeSearch for Common Ground, uye nebudiriro yehunyanzvi inotungamirwa neMurtaza Qanie. Yakagadzirwa kuti iite ruzivo nezveVechidiki, Runyararo uye Chengetedzo agenda - yakamisikidzwa muUN Security Council Resolution 2250 - inowanikwa uye kusimbisa kufamba kweYPS pakati pemasangano, vadzidzi, uye vanoita mitemo.
aboutSourcesDescription: Chishandiso ichi chakavakirwa pahwaro hweruzivo hwakachengetedzwa hunosanganisira zvisungo nezvirongwa zveUN zvinowanika pachena, zvinyorwa zveUN, magwaro esangano redunhu, zvirongwa zvezvekuita nenyika, tsvakiridzo yedzidzo, uye zvinyorwa zvinobva kumasangano everuzhinji nemasangano asiri ehurumende.
